query: As of July 2026, what is the financial/bankruptcy status of Beyond Meat Inc? Has it filed for Chapter 11 or restructured debt? Any bankruptcy warnings, going concern doubts, debt restructuring, or imminent bankruptcy risk in 2025-2026?
answer:
Research complete. Summary of findings on **Beyond Meat Inc (BYND) financial/bankruptcy status as of July 2026**:

**No Chapter 11 filing** — Beyond Meat has not filed for bankruptcy and explicitly denies planning to. But it is in severe distress:

- **October 2025 distressed restructuring** averted a likely near-term bankruptcy: ~97% of noteholders swapped >$1.1B of 2027 convertible notes for new 7% notes due 2030 (~$203-209M) plus ~316-326M new shares — cutting debt from ~$1.15B toward ~$250M but causing catastrophic dilution (shares: 76.65M → ~455M) and a ~56% stock crash.
- **Stock ~$0.59** (July 17, 2026), down ~92% from its 52-week high, penny-stock territory with Nasdaq delisting risk; market cap ~$305M.
- **Q1 2026:** revenue $58.2M (-15.3% YoY), net loss $28.5M, cash & restricted cash $205.8M, cash burn improved to $11.8M.
- **Warning signs:** delayed 2025 10-K, disclosed material weakness in internal controls, "critical" credit health rating, and ongoing July 17, 2026 negotiations with 2030 noteholders over the remaining 2027 notes.
- **Trajectory:** The restructuring pushed the maturity wall from 2027 to 2030 and reduced leverage, but revenue keeps falling with no clear path to profitability — bankruptcy risk is deferred, not eliminated.

The full markdown report and structured data (key facts, sources, and 17 data points) have been delivered.

key_facts: Beyond Meat has NOT filed for Chapter 11 as of July 2026 and states it is not planning to file for bankruptcy.

In October 2025 Beyond Meat completed a distressed debt-for-equity restructuring: ~97% of holders exchanged over $1.1 billion of 2027 convertible notes for new 7% Convertible Senior Secured Second Lien PIK Toggle Notes due 2030 (~$203-209M) plus ~316-326 million new shares.
The restructuring cut total debt from ~$1.15 billion toward ~$250 million but caused massive dilution: share count rose from ~76.65 million to ~455 million.
The stock crashed ~56% on October 13, 2025 on the dilution news and traded near $0.59 on July 17, 2026, down ~92% from its 52-week high of $7.69 (penny-stock / Nasdaq delisting risk).
Q1 2026 (ended March 28, 2026): revenue $58.2M (-15.3% YoY), net loss $28.5M (-$0.06/share), cash & restricted cash $205.8M, carrying value of debt $411.6M.
Cash burn improved to $11.8M in Q1 2026, described as lowest in over 2 years; operating cash use only $5M vs $26.1M a year earlier.
Revenue has declined every quarter YoY through 2025 into 2026; Q4 2025 revenue was $61.6M (-19.7% YoY).
Q4 2025 posted positive net income (+$370.9M) only due to a large non-cash gain (~$523-549M) from the debt exchange, despite an operating loss of -$130.2M.
Red flags: delayed 2025 10-K filing (filed ~April 8, 2026), disclosed material weakness in internal controls over inventory accounting, and credit health rated 'critical' by analysts.

On July 17, 2026, Beyond Meat disclosed private talks with 2030 noteholders to loosen limits on repurchasing/exchanging remaining 2027 convertible notes and extend the make-whole period, with 'no assurance' consents will be obtained.
Analysts characterize the restructuring as buying time (maturity pushed from 2027 to 2030) but providing no clear path to profitability, with bankruptcy risk deferred rather than eliminated.
